company.name: Lorryz
company.shortDescription: Lorryz is an innovative online market place and digital platform through web and smart phone app.
company.description: Lorryz is a Dubai-based digital freight network offering innovative transportation and logistics solutions across the Middle East. The platform enables businesses and carriers to streamline road freight operations through instant rate quotations, real-time shipment tracking, AI-powered logistics management, and automated freight matching. Lorryz helps reduce operational inefficiencies, optimize routes, minimize empty truck runs, and improve transparency between shippers and transporters. Its web and mobile platforms support shipment management, contract handling, fleet visibility, and sustainable logistics practices for modern supply chain operations.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,889,072 to $12,590,040, a 1.6x increase.
